The state of 15 October is at commit 0220fb3 (fileSha256 301304175bad6fb9…, headGraphHash 74c743aca0dfd4a4…). As there, graph hashes from revision 1 on differ from copies made before 2026-10-14, when the graph history was rebuilt.
